consoleDescription: Sign in with Riot to show your Valorant stats in chat. !val shows your competitive rank, !val matches shows your recent ranked games, and !val lb shows the top 10 of the act leaderboard. Player stats come only from the Riot account you linked.
metaTitle: Valorant Rank Command for Twitch | ItsBagelBot
metaDesc: Sign in with Riot to share your Valorant rank, recent matches and more in Twitch chat. See the official act leaderboard with !val lb.
title: Your Valorant rank in Twitch chat.
lead: Sign in with Riot to share your own Valorant rank and recent matches in Twitch chat. Valorant Stats is free.
step1Desc: Enable Valorant Stats and choose Sign in with Riot on the Riot account card.
step2Desc: Sign in on Riot’s own page and approve access. Back in the dashboard, the card says Linked as Name#Tag.
step3Desc: Type !val, !val record, !val matches, !val lb or !val account in Twitch chat.
limitsNote: The module is off by default. Each command has a 10 second cooldown.
faqQ1: How do I show my Valorant rank in Twitch chat?
faqA1: Enable Valorant Stats and choose Sign in with Riot. Once you approve access, viewers can type !val to see your current rank and RR.
faqQ2: Do I need to install anything on my gaming PC?
faqA2: The command runs through ItsBagelBot and posts the reply in Twitch chat. You can use it without installing an app or adding an overlay.
faqA3: Yes. Valorant Stats is included in the free plan.
faqQ4: How do I unlink my Riot account?
faqA4: Choose Unlink on the same Riot account card. Twitch chat stops showing your stats within a few minutes.
legal: ItsBagelBot is not affiliated with or endorsed by Riot Games.
tblNote: Each command has its own on/off switch and message template in the dashboard.
prereq1: Enable Valorant Stats in the dashboard. The module is off by default.
prereq2: A Riot account linked with Sign in with Riot.
item1Desc: Player stats come only from the streamer’s signed-in Riot account.
item2Desc: !val lb shows the official PC leaderboard’s top 10 for the current act.
item3Desc: Use na, eu, ap, kr, br or latam. Leave it blank to let the bot detect the account’s region.
item4Desc: PC is the default. Choose the console ladder to see console ranks.
item6Desc: Players who hide their name on Riot’s leaderboard appear as “Secret Agent”.
